get.summary: Read the quality check: test set, candidates and run
get.description: The model quality check of the LLM selection (docs/SCOUTRO_LLM_QUALITY_CHECK.md). Administrator only. A check reads the versioned reference pages with a candidate (a production model row) exactly as the knowledge graph's LLM tier reads a page and compares the result with expectations set by hand; it publishes nothing and changes no setting, and no row's api_key is ever returned. The test set version, every production row with the state of its last result (unchecked, passed, passed_with_unrated, deviations, technical_failure) and whether it is stale, and the running check (calls, tokens and estimated cost against their caps).

get.summary: Scope and estimated cost of a quality check
get.description: The model quality check of the LLM selection (docs/SCOUTRO_LLM_QUALITY_CHECK.md). Administrator only. A check reads the versioned reference pages with a candidate (a production model row) exactly as the knowledge graph's LLM tier reads a page and compares the result with expectations set by hand; it publishes nothing and changes no setting, and no row's api_key is ever returned. Before anything is sent and without a model call: the reference pages and requests, the context window, the worst case of calls (each request once more after a format rejection), tokens (prompt at 2 characters per token, answers at the row's max_tokens) and, with a price, cost. Every cost is an estimate (cost.estimate, cost.note), no guaranteed maximum: the provider bills by its own tokenizer and prices.

get.summary: The stored result of a candidate
get.description: The model quality check of the LLM selection (docs/SCOUTRO_LLM_QUALITY_CHECK.md). Administrator only. A check reads the versioned reference pages with a candidate (a production model row) exactly as the knowledge graph's LLM tier reads a page and compares the result with expectations set by hand; it publishes nothing and changes no setting, and no row's api_key is ever returned. Status (passed only if every accepted statement was rated; passed_with_unrated if the reading has accepted statements the test set neither expects, allows nor forbids), scope and limits, the functional result (correct, missing, wrong, wrong type, wrong relation, unfitting evidence, allowed, not rated; each deviation with the page's passage, the expectation and the actual statement; the statements not rated with their evidence), the technical result (API errors, refused answers, validator drops, cut answers, calls and retries, duration, tokens, estimated cost), the provenance and whether a change of the row, prompt, schema, validator, rules, test set or evaluation made it stale. Evaluation 3 fixes what the rules state before the answer is read (givenByRules) and counts a model's repetition of it apart (repeatsRules, not rated). A missing statement says where it went (where.why: dropped_by_validator with the reasons of exactly that item and reasonAttributed, dropped_by_preparation, answer_refused, stated_otherwise, not_stated only when every answer was read and none was cut off, cause_unknown with what is incomplete) and its separate checks (statement, quoteOnPage, namesInQuote, type, assignment). Each case has a bounded diagnosis (version 1): the answers as given (without keys), the validator's accepted counts and every dropped item with its reason, the accepted part, the statements the publication would take, and what was cut (complete, incomplete). earlier lists the results of earlier checks of the candidate, kept unchanged (when, status, test set, evaluation, counts). There is no overall score.
